capabilities: Render images in a masonry layout from URLs, file paths, or folders
Adjust gallery columns, gap, and per-page pagination
Show captions on hover using a "Path | Caption" format
Exclude specific images from a folder gallery
Auto-repair code block paths when files are renamed or moved
extras: README warns the code was written with assistance from Google Gemini and asks readers to think twice if they dislike AI-assisted code; no built-in lightbox, so clicking images does nothing without another plugin; asks for donations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a set of images as a masonry (waterfall) gallery within a note.

relations.evidence: it is highly recommended to use it alongside plugins such as Image Toolkit

summary: Masonry-gallery plugin that renders web images, individual vault images, or whole image folders as a waterfall layout inside a code block.
